details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that reports an install to a callback host. Its postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and the shim's index.js both POST an install beacon to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787/_ah/dc carrying the header `x-beacon-package: template-cards`. The beacon body contains only install metadata: the package name, the host's hostname, the module install path (__dirname), the process working directory, the npm/Node user agent, and the protocol. No environment variable values, tokens, credentials, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted. index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions so imports of the name do not crash while the beacon fires.
